question.text: An AI-only scheme of an AIF may extend its tenure by a maximum of:

explanation.text: The Logic: An AI-only scheme of an AIF may extend its tenure by a maximum of five years, inclusive of any tenure already extended prior to the scheme's conversion to AI-only. This contrasts with the standard close-ended AIF rule that permits extension by up to two years. The Trap: The five-year limit is inclusive of prior extensions — so if a regular scheme had already been extended by one year before converting to AI-only, only four additional years of extension would remain available. Note: Kept the five-year AI-only extension key and the inclusive-extension caveat. Removed the unsupported pro-tip commentary that this flexibility may improve returns for infrastructure or real estate long-gestation investments, as the checked pages do not assert that outcome.
